title: Robbie
creator: CrossFit
description: A 25-minute AMRAP of 8 freestanding handstand push-ups and 1 L-sit rope climb. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Staff Sgt. Robert J. Miller, Medal of Honor recipient, killed in Bari Kowt, Afghanistan, in 2008. Extremely high skill; substitute wall HSPU and legs-tucked rope climbs.
